profile.name: Punnawit Rodsai
profile.bio: I'm a 23-year-old Computer Science graduate from Phetchaburi Rajabhat University, specializing in backend development with full-stack flexibility. I am deeply passionate about architecting stable, high-performance systems and managing databases using Spring Boot, Go, and Node.js. Always eager to learn and adapt to emerging technologies.

projects.title: Digital Document Wallet (VC WALLET)
details: Developed secure RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express to interact with Oracle DB for storing and managing digital documents.
Implemented asynchronous API integrations with the NDID platform, handling callbacks and wait states for identity verification.
Applied enterprise-level security protocols, including data encryption/decryption, hashing, and digital signatures, to ensure document authenticity.
Formatted and optimized application logs for the ELK Stack by trimming long data fields to ensure clear error tracking, while conducting API performance and load testing using JMeter.

projects.title: NDID BOT Settlement
details: Developed an automated Settlement Bot to download monthly CSV and XLSX report files from the NDID Portal for transaction reconciliation.
Configured multi-database connections between NDID and VC Wallet DB, keeping execution isolated to ensure zero impact on the production database.
Implemented database transactions for bulk data insertion, ensuring an all-or-nothing rollback if any single record fails to prevent invalid data.
Integrated automated SMTP email notifications to send execution logs, status summaries, and failure alerts to system administrators after each batch run.

projects.title: Settlement Audit Dashboard (Internal BU Tool)
details: Developed an internal web dashboard in Angular for Business Unit (BU) staff to audit and verify billing reconciliation reports.
Implemented step-by-step dynamic form validation to enforce date range constraints and sequential selection flows.
Integrated backend REST APIs to trigger and handle direct browser downloads of generated .xlsx report files.

projects.title: LINE OA AI Receipt OCR & Voice Rewards
details: Developed a scalable backend system using NestJS and Fastify to handle Webhooks from LINE Official Account (LINE OA) for automated user engagement.
Implemented secure webhook validation by verifying LINE signatures and headers to prevent unauthorized requests.
Designed an integration workflow with an internal OCR service to process image uploads, extract financial data, and automatically calculate and reward loyalty points.
Built a Rate Limiting mechanism to throttle incoming webhook requests, protecting the server from abuse and providing automated cool-down responses to users.

projects.title: Trade Finance Service (Doc Check)
details: Engineered a centralized document repository in NestJS and TypeORM with smart PDF file versioning, replacing duplicate LC master files or appending related documents into a merged PDF.
Built secure file streaming services to render multi-page PDF previews directly on the web interface.
Integrated OCR and LLM pipelines to extract trade finance data and automatically identify document discrepancy fields.
Developed an interactive report UI featuring synchronized visual highlighting between table data and PDF locations, including color-coded error indicators and field-level discrepancy selectors.
Implemented automated Excel (.xlsx) report generation enabling users to export structured audit results directly from the discrepancy table.
